Overview

Salem is a city in Tamil Nadu with a population of 920,000. A major industrial city in Tamil Nadu, known for its steel plants, textile mills, and mango orchards. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
